segments.name: commercial real estate
segments.description: Acquires, owns and manages primarily single-tenant properties net leased on a long-term basis to middle-market operators.
segments.evidence: Therefore, the Company aggregates these investments for reporting purposes and operates in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Middle-market operators pay us contractual base rent under long-term net leases on properties we own.
revenueModel.evidence: Our properties generally are subject to long-term net leases that we believe provide us a stable base of revenue from which to grow our portfolio.
